summary.one_liner: Notion is an AI workspace where teams combine notes, knowledge, search, and AI agents to capture context, find answers, and automate tasks.
use_cases: capture team knowledge in one place
get answers with citations from workspace content
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Notion as an AI workspace for teams and agents. It says users can capture knowledge into a single system of record, and get answers instantly with citations. It offers Custom Agents that automate tasks and keep work running around the clock. It also lists search across connected apps and example workflows such as triaging product feedback, resolving Slack support tickets, responding to security alerts, automating weekly reports, and building custom developer tools. The page is mostly marketing, so specific feature details are limited.
